# System

The repository contains a Conduit-style single-page application under `src/app`. The application is the system under test for RealWorld conformance. The `realworld` tree holds the shared specification pack: OpenAPI contract, Bruno and Hurl API tests, Playwright end-to-end suites, Astro documentation, and brand assets. The SPA sends HTTP requests to a backend base URL configured at build or test time. Shared E2E tests gate behavior with `TEST_MODE`, `BROWSER_API`, and `EXTERNAL_API` from [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts). Agent work starts at [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Domain terms live in [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md). Contracts are indexed in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md).

## Components

### `src/app` (Angular implementation)

The Angular application implements Conduit user flows: authentication, articles, comments, profiles, settings, and feeds. Route definitions live in [src/app/app.routes.ts](src/app/app.routes.ts). The root [package.json](package.json) wires Vitest unit tests and Playwright runs against this SPA. Implementers follow [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md). Unit verification uses [skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md). End-to-end verification uses [skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md).

**Entry points:** The dev server is started per root Playwright configuration (inferred from [realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts)). `bun run build` produces a production Angular build ([package.json](package.json)). `bun run test` runs colocated Vitest specs under `src/app`.

**Interfaces:** The SPA must expose routes and DOM selectors documented in `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md` (see [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md)). The client stores the session token under `localStorage` key `jwtToken`. Implementations may expose `window.__conduit_debug__` for test introspection.

**Dependencies:** The app depends on the configured API base (often `https://api.realworld.show/api` in tests). It does not import `realworld` application runtime code.

### `realworld` (conformance pack)

The `realworld` tree defines how implementers prove API and frontend compliance. It publishes documentation, runs contract tests, and hosts shared Playwright specs. Local guidance is in [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md).

**Responsibilities:** OpenAPI defines the REST surface in [realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml](realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml). E2E specs under `realworld/specs/e2e/*.spec.ts` exercise any compliant frontend. [realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts) exports shared Playwright defaults. The docs site uses Astro Starlight via [realworld/docs/astro.config.mjs](realworld/docs/astro.config.mjs).

**Entry points:** Root [package.json](package.json) scripts `test:e2e` and `test:e2e:security` point Playwright at `realworld/specs/e2e`. API runners include `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh` and `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh` (inventory). Docs dev uses scripts in `realworld/docs/package.json` (analysis).

**Interfaces:** Reference server URL `https://api.realworld.show/api` appears in OpenAPI. Protected calls use `Authorization: Token <jwt>`. E2E helpers call paths such as `/users`, `/users/login`, `/user`, `/articles`, `/articles/{slug}/comments`, and `/profiles/{username}/follow`.

**Dependencies:** Playwright ([realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts)), Bruno CLI and Hurl for API tests, Astro for docs. E2E mode flags are defined in [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts).

### Root orchestration

The repository root connects the SPA, Playwright, and Vitest. [package.json](package.json) defines `test`, `test:e2e`, `test:e2e:security`, `build`, and format scripts. [TESTING.md](TESTING.md) consolidates verification workflows. [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md) lists active and proposed git hooks.

## Data flow

1. A user opens the SPA. The router loads a component for a path from [src/app/app.routes.ts](src/app/app.routes.ts).
2. Auth flows post credentials to the backend login or register endpoints. The SPA stores `jwtToken` in `localStorage` on success.
3. Authenticated requests attach `Authorization: Token` with the JWT. Article, comment, profile, and favorite actions map to OpenAPI paths in [realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml](realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml).
4. Playwright starts the SPA web server and sets `baseURL` per root `playwright.config.ts` and [realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts).
5. E2E helpers read `API_BASE` from [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts). The default is `https://api.realworld.show/api` unless `API_BASE` overrides it.
6. When `EXTERNAL_API` is true, helpers register users and seed data via direct HTTP to `API_BASE` before UI steps.
7. When `BROWSER_API` is true, specs may intercept browser routes with `page.route` to assert client HTTP handling without changing server behavior.
8. `TEST_MODE` and related flags skip or branch tests for SPA-only, API-backed, or mixed architectures ([GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md)).
9. Documentation content under `realworld/docs/src/content` builds through Astro into static output for publishing (analysis cites deploy workflow).
